elements.element: Transition assistance provided by Vendor on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: "Upon termination of the Agreement: ... (v) at Customer's request, Kubient shall provide reasonable transition assistance"; item (vi) expressly covers "termination or expiration"

elements.element: Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: "within thirty (30) days of termination or expiration, Kubient shall return to Customer ... all Content, Requests and other data of or relating to Customer"

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.evidence: "thereafter Kubient shall delete such Content, Requests and data from its systems"
"certify such deletion to Customer in writing"
"for up to six (6) months" exceeds 90 days
"within thirty (30) days of termination or expiration, Kubient shall return to Customer ... machine-readable format"

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present in operative text: assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, return of Customer data within 30 days of termination or expiration in a commonly used machine-readable format, and deletion plus written certification thereafter.

The request condition attaches only to transition assistance (item (v)); the data return and deletion/certification duties in (vi)-(vii) are unconditional and run from termination or expiration, not from a later request, so the mandatory return mechanic is not swallowed.

Minor, non-material softeners: assistance is "reasonable" and "at Customer's request", and the assistance limb sits under the "Upon termination" preamble while only (vi) recites "termination or expiration" — note in rationale rather than redline.

Insertion is a concise addition to an absent obligation; existing sub-clauses (i)-(iv) are untouched and no undefined term or contradiction is introduced ("Content" and "Requests" track the Agreement's defined usage).
